comments.value: Ive been wishing for this for a long time. We never had abuse in Altspace, and events in menu were amazing. Ive been asking devs to do this every chance I get. Nobody can find our events. Please implement this. It would make VRChat so much more useful.

@{60f27ab54dc3b21b95ac9e76|full_name}: i fully agree.  An event system is sorely missing from VRChat.  With the hundreds or even thousands of unique features it already has over its competitors,  it is hard to believe it is missing this basic component

Yea i wanna announce when i am having cheeseburgers early in the afternoon lets goooo >~< 

Sorry a little sarcasm aint gonna hurt>~>’

In 2024, this would probably be done via groups, although having invite-based events for friends would be cool too (i.e. the "date with Rom" example). For groups especially, having a new instance pre-configured and launched either at the event start or some time before-hand would be great too.

Maybe make binding the event to an instance or world optional, so larger events can be coordinated. This system could then work simply for RSVP and, after accepting it, notifications.

this is a great idea, i would add:

1) group events that are automatically added to the calendar to all members of the group of course with the option to opt out of those notifications.

2) public group events that can be signed up for through the groups page

3) friends only events that are created by sending a request to the selected friends for them to accept and add it to their calendar.

4) creating events and reminders just for myself

5) Events set by VRCchat for officially supported and promoted events like VKET, new years eve, etc.

6) a discovery page for public group events to sign up for them like SHELTER for example without the need of being a member of said group

So as I replied to Tom Ley, it could be rolled out to only trusted users at first and mitigated by only allowing an event a week like where I can't upload a world everyday. I have to wait a week. Also, can have recurring events. I think if the devs think along these lines, they could mitigate a lot of the people creating meetings every second of every day. There are solutions.

I've also thought about how nice it would be to have discovery like worlds have. It would help people learn about new groups, new worlds, and of course new events! Some smaller worlds that nobody visits that would be perfect for certain use-cases can start seeing the attention and use they deserve. In other words, musicians wouldn't have to always perform at the Black Cat to find new people.

@{60f27ab54dc3b21b95ac9e76|full_name} I want to say the events/calendar feature should be available to all groups and all users, no special requirements. But discovery could have some algorithmic constraints: events created by trusted groups and users might have greater weight than brand-new groups or events created by new users; events too far out or scheduled too close to them happening could be (temporarily) suppressed; groups that frequently schedule events would be deprioritized; events at PC-only worlds shouldn't be promoted to Android/Quest players (even if they're in the group for it)... and of course, abuse can be reported, even if most people won't see it.

edit: I think a relatively high limit to fight general spam (10 events per week, per group/user in whatever combination) might also be nice, but that's really just for server resource purposes.

One more addition: auto-join sounds like a bad idea. It should probably work as an invite that gets issued as soon as the event world opens, if you've signed up for it. That way you can join it just the same.

i know there's a site for VRChat events that keep track of most of them, we could try to get the info off it and load it in and a tab when click get updated

that means VRChat would need to get API data off the site and load it in to the menus. its not that hard they do it with the friends list.
Everyone! I am happy to tell ya! They actually started working on it after so long!!! So I guess they should change it into In Progress :D
Still wondering if Zarniwoop ever went on that date with Rom. How did it go?

Thank you for your suggestion!

VRChat introduced the event calendar in version 2025.3.1 (in July).

https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrchat-202531openbeta

details:
Having an calendar in-game would let people who are not on slack actually know what kinds of stuff is happening! (And it looks/is better imho)

There would be a calendar button on the menu and clicking it would bring up a window similar to WoW's calendar
( https://www.blogcdn.com/wow.joystiq.com/media/2010/11/decembercalendarchangesrlt.jpg )
Users would be able to select a date, create an event and other people could sign up for it.

The creator would be able to set a starting time for the event and choose a world which it would be at.
Since this is a global community I think it would be best to use UTC time to coordinate everyone, and if possible, setting your own time-zone in settings and having VRchat convert the times to your local time.

Before the event starts a notification would appear (As shown in picture) so you can hang out with friends and not forget the time. An option to auto-join the event world 5-15-30 minutes before would be handy too!
title: In-game event calendar
